# Tasks — 2026-08-02

## Task 1: Model ID validation helper (config, small, MODERATE)

**What**: Create a `validateModelId` helper function that validates model IDs against the SAP AI Core catalog and folds aliases onto canonical IDs.

**Files**:
- `src/providers/index.ts` — Add `validateModelId(modelId: string): string` function
- `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` — Ensure `ORCHESTRATION_MODELS` is accessible
- `tests/providers/validate-model.test.ts` — Unit tests for validation logic

**Implementation details**:
- Function should check if model ID exists in `ORCHESTRATION_MODELS`
- Handle alias spellings (if SAP AI Core has any alias patterns)
- Return canonical model ID if valid
- Return fallback model ID if unknown (use existing `resolveFallbackModelId`)
- Emit warning on first unknown model per process lifetime (reuse existing `warnedFor` pattern)

**Done when**:
- [ ] `validateModelId` function exists in `src/providers/index.ts`
- [ ] Function validates against `ORCHESTRATION_MODELS`
- [ ] Unknown IDs fall back to configured default
- [ ] Unit tests cover: valid unchanged, unknown defaulted, idempotent calls
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass

## Task 2: Wire model validation into router (config, small, MODERATE)

**What**: Integrate `validateModelId` into the routing config loader so invalid model IDs in `routing-config.json` are caught at startup.

**Files**:
- `src/config/routingConfig.ts` — Add validation call in `loadRoutingConfig`
- `src/core/router.ts` — Ensure router uses validated model IDs
- `tests/config/routingConfig.test.ts` — Integration tests

**Implementation details**:
- In `loadRoutingConfig`, validate each model ID in the config
- Replace invalid IDs with fallback model
- Log warning when model ID is replaced
- Preserve other route config fields unchanged

**Done when**:
- [ ] `loadRoutingConfig` validates all model IDs
- [ ] Invalid IDs are replaced with fallback
- [ ] Warnings logged for replaced IDs
- [ ] Tests verify: valid config unchanged, invalid IDs replaced, routing still works
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass
